name: Ask an optional local assistant
summary: Choose a configured local text model for a bounded subtask.
description: Optionally delegate one bounded text-only subtask to an id discovered with models.list. Choose any configured model; none is preferred and consultation is never required. The supervisor checks the frozen model allowlist, permissions, exact digest, call budget, context, free memory and a single model lease. Models cannot call tools or recurse and their replies are untrusted data. No conversation history or media is shared automatically. The UTF-8 prompt byte guard plus output/framing reserves must fit configured context; models.list reports the effective limit. Output tokens include hidden reasoning where the model uses it; empty outputs are reported as failures. Calls may include cold loading, are timed/cancellable and consume one reservation even when they fail. A model server may finish cancellation/unload later; finite keep-alive bounds crash residency. The truncated flag reports a server length stop; partial text is not a completed subtask.

demonstrations.title: Ask for a short critique

input.prompt: Give one limitation of using a single example to test a claim. Reply in one sentence.

demonstrations.explanation: Actual Simulation demonstrations consume a consultation and return real model output. Builder self-tests inject a labelled fake service and check schemas only.

limitations: Optional bounded text assistance, not an autonomous inhabitant or trusted advice.
Configured profile order is stable by id and conveys no preference or quality ranking.
Only the supplied prompt is shared. No tools, history, media inputs or host access.
Memory admission is cooperative; model servers remain outside sandbox/job hard limits.
models.ask failures, empty outputs and uncertain calls consume reservations; no retry or substitute.

failure_modes.condition: Server unavailable, timeout, identity mismatch or oversize output.
failure_modes.recovery: Treat the missing answer as missing evidence.
